verdicts.claim_scope: RF-03 phase 0, asset side of MT-36248: typed GpuClientPort (admit, authorize, settle, rebind, counters) with AdmissionRequest attribution, non-Clone GpuGrant, Settlement Measured/Estimated/Unknown, ClientRefusal, SettleError, public GrantLedger (settle-once: DoubleRelease, LateRelease, StaleGrant, InFlight); TransientAdapter (asset-local, Vulkan first on Windows, 256 MiB studio_declared budget), UnavailablePort, external-device adapter behind SharedDevice::new (signature unchanged, Host-shaped grant, rebind = DeviceLost); GpuBackend::with_grant (residency budget = grant budget, authorize before every submission, reacquire = rebind, release settle-once, drop = abandoned counted); GpuContext crate-private, BackendChoice and DeviceOptions.backend behind the test-only feature asset-local-backends (harness dev-dependency line); compile_fail doctests; DESCRIPTOR device section, report_port. Two changes to other lanes' tests: gpu_pipeline_fault FXC expectations per backend (DX12 unchanged, NOT_PROVEN off DX12) and the threshold exact-tie rule in ext_adjustment_layer_parity (boundary band 2^-20, NOT_PROVEN, new pin test). Asset-local evidence only, never host acceptance (AC-HOST-005); MT-36248 HOST-CASES stay PLANNED.

rows.1 no egui / wgpu type in a new public si: PASS: mechanical scan of every pub (not pub(crate)) fn/struct/enum/const/type/trait signature and pub field in render-gpu src at 66c62129: only plan_sink/shared.rs items name wgpu (TARGET_FORMAT, SharedDevice::new with its unchanged signature, render_to_texture), all behind feature shared-device and pre-existing; GpuContext is pub(crate) and no longer re-exported (compile_fail E0433/E0603); BackendChoice and DeviceOptions.backend exist only with asset-local-backends (compile_fail E0433/E0560 without it); no ash/Vulkan type anywhere; client.rs, client/transient.rs, client/external.rs public items are plain data
rows.2 no new GPU device/instance/queue/pool/: PASS: the device opening moved from the public GpuContext::acquire into the crate-private transient adapter (device::acquire_lease), the asset-local stand-in that D3, the brief and HBR-HOST-003 sanction until MT-203 exists (asset_local true, excluded from host acceptance, AC-HOST-005); the 256 MiB budget is the existing default moved onto the grant (studio_declared); SharedDevice adopts the caller's device and opens none (rebind = DeviceLost); no new pool or allocator
rows.3 controls registry: PASS (not applicable): no command or control
rows.4 actor: PASS: GPU admission is not a document-mutating op; AdmissionRequest carries opaque module/client/device attribution; the compatibility paths (GpuBackend::new, SharedDevice::new) use ModuleRef/ClientRef::UNREGISTERED (0 = not supplied) exactly as the brief specifies; no ActorContext, default_actor() or literal actor; harness-view call sites that must attribute are listed in the lane file for the GUI lane
rows.5 observe, no text: PASS with finding: every terminal port outcome is a closed PortEvent code and a PortCounters counter; report_port emits the closed observe Outcome only (no text, path, adapter name or id); no producer calls it yet and it is untested (F-R46-3)
rows.6 jobs: PASS: admission through the GPU client port, not the session JobPort; no queue, worker or job added

host_integration.hbr: HBR-HOST-003: admission before work (admit at construction, authorize before each submission in execute_inner and execute_grade), budget = grant budget, Measured retained/peak attributed to module/client/device, native driver Unknown, settle exactly once (ledger: DoubleRelease, LateRelease, StaleGrant), in-flight work never settled (InFlight; drop waits at most 10 s, then the refusal leaves the grant outstanding and counted), device loss rebinds through the port (generation + 1), unavailable/lost typed with no CPU fallback; transient adapter = asset-local evidence only. Gaps: F-R46-3 (deny path untested), F-R46-4 (shared-device flag write before authorize), F-R46-5 (ledger growth, HBR-HOST-004); build infrastructure: F-R46-8 (the harness dev-dependency line gives every harness unit new artifact identities: 140.9 GiB in this union)
